amendments.actual_body_review: Unconditional source-attributed Draw; actual new attack context and waiting recovery reviewed, no original minion-play predicate in body.

native_guard_review.event: Bind unique terminal completed CharacterAttackRecord by original event sequence/source/target, then actual own hero/self/attacked/neighbor policy. Bare CombatDamage is not a declared constructed attack.
native_guard_review.hound: Original early own attacker/minion-target qualification, then same automatic empty choice continuation as native, original attack-source presence, later same owner/live/active/not doomed; selected body only after surviving guard.
native_guard_review.body: Separate survival predicate from effect. Split amount is current source attack in ordinary context and actual DeathRecord.attack in deathrattle; split uses existing non-spell profile and minion-ability attribution.
